messages:
alex_qonexa: Hey @maya_csm — onboarding check-in. Our P95 latency jumped from 310ms -> 540ms last week, and cost per 1k requests is up 22%. Renewal flags are starting to pop internally. Any quick levers we can try before the exec review next Wed?

maya_csm: thanks for the heads-up. saw the spike in our dashboard. quick Q — what percent of requests are short prompts (<64 tokens) vs long (>512)?

alex_qonexa: approx 78% short, 15% medium, 7% long. Most traffic is inference-only (no tools).

sam_se: (cc @dina_pm) for PM visibility. High level: for that mix we can try 1) int8 quantization for the model, 2) route short prompts to a faster, quantized variant, 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. Low-risk and should cut cost/latency.

maya_csm: propose this plan: Day 0 — create quantized model artifact (int8), Day 1 — canary 5% routing for short prompts, Day 3 — ramp to 50% if no regressions. Also capture eval set for regen checks.

alex_qonexa: sounds good. How do we validate quality after quantization? execs worry about hallucinations.

sam_se: we run a prompt-level regression test: sample 200 representative short prompts from Qonexa production (we can pick from last 7 days), compute BLEU/ROUGE and a small human spot-check. Also attach automatic quality alert if semantic similarity drops below threshold.

maya_csm: I'll coordinate enablement session with your engineering leads. Suggest Wed 10am PT — 30m. @alex_qonexa can your infra folks make that?

alex_qonexa: yes, booked 30m. invite sent.

dina_pm: quick ask from product — if we route short prompts to a quantized fallback, can devs opt-out for critical flows? We want fine-grained routing by route-tag.

sam_se: yes. routing policy supports match by route tags and header flags. example snippet to route short, non-critical requests:

```
{"routing": [
  {"match": {"route_tag":"search_short","critical":false}, "model":"redwood-llama-quant-int8"},
  {"match": {"route_tag":"search_short","critical":true}, "model":"redwood-llama-8bit-precision"}
]}
```

maya_csm: ops-bot will run a smoke deploy check when we start the canary.

ops-bot: deploybot — canary rollout scheduled for 1768090000, will notify on errors >1% or latency P95 > 750ms :robot_face:

alex_qonexa: any idea expected wins? we need numbers for renewal slides.

sam_se: rough estimates: int8 quant + routing to faster variant -> ~30% cost reduction on short prompts, P95 latency drop to ~260-320ms for routed traffic. KV caching could save another 10–15% token cost for repeated prefixes.

maya_csm: added action items: 1) sam: produce quant artifact + eval suite by EOD Tue (1768060000), 2) maya: enablement + invite done, 3) alex: share sample prompt corpus (anonymized). I'll open a ticket with tracking.

alex_qonexa: sending corpus now. Also capturing a couple of customer complaints we'll attach.

dina_pm: thanks all — if the canary is clean we'll include the cost/latency delta in renewal pack. keep me posted.

maya_csm: noted. TL;DR — low-risk quant + routing can buy Qonexa breathing room for renewal conversation. next sync after canary results. :thumbsup:
